title: The Menu, Week 4
dek: Refreshed after Friday's injury report: C.J. Stroud is QB12, Puka Nacua WR11, Dontayvion Wicks WR33 with DeVonta Smith out, and the questionable Ladd McConkey and Terry McLaurin slide into the flex range.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Sun 12:25 PM ET: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is inactive in London, so pivot to Stefon Diggs, WR27 for me, a high-end WR3. Ladd McConkey (foot) is expected to play at SEA and stays WR39, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Tyjae Spears (ankle) is active; Tony Pollard stays RB29, a high-end RB3. Zay Flowers (WR9) and Kenyon Sadiq (TE14, a borderline start) are active.

Updated Sat 6:25 PM ET: Carolina elevated receiver Ja'Seem Reed Saturday, the move Dave Canales said would mean Jalen Coker (quad) cannot go vs DET. Darren Waller is TE18 for me, a streamer for Sunday night; Coker is outside my top 50 receivers either way.

Updated Sat 12:25 PM ET: Keenan Allen (groin) is ruled out for London, so pivot to Wan'Dale Robinson (WR38); Josh Downs stays WR15 and Tyler Warren picks up targets. Terry McLaurin is still questionable, but Washington's beat reporting says he is likely to miss; he is WR40 for me only if active, with Stefon Diggs (WR27) next up.

Updated Fri 5:50 PM ET: Zay Flowers (hamstring) is questionable after a limited Friday practice the Ravens listed as rest, following a full Thursday. He stays WR9 for me vs TEN; check Sunday's inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

Updated Fri 5:20 PM ET with the final injury report: Jadarian Price is out, so Emanuel Wilson moves up to RB31 in a split with George Holani; Nico Collins and DJ Moore have no designation; Keenan Allen missed Friday's practice and drops to WR36, questionable; Kenyon Sadiq was limited all week and slips to TE14, questionable.

Week 4 has no byes and a lot of empty chairs. Caleb Williams, Baker Mayfield and Jaxson Dart are out at quarterback, De'Von Achane and Jordan Mason are on IR, Travis Etienne is out for Monday night, Rico Dowdle has not practiced on a short week, and Breece Hall is week to week. Every one of them has a pivot listed under Off the Menu. Rankings are for full PPR.

The biggest moves come from the snap counts, not the box scores. Warren is a top-10 back with 90 percent of the snaps and 20 touches in Dowdle's absence before Thursday's game at CLE. Chuba Hubbard (RB12) and Aaron Jones Sr. (RB13) sit on the RB1/RB2 line on deployment: 19 carries and 84 percent of the snaps for Hubbard, 78 percent of Minnesota's carries for Jones against the defense that has allowed the most points to running backs. Omarion Hampton lost his passing downs, Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin have an undrafted rookie at quarterback, and Brian Thomas Jr. is playing 37 percent of the snaps.

Nico Collins (hamstring) is questionable at WR13: he practiced Wednesday and Thursday for the first time since the hamstring, and Friday decides it. Prep Notes revisits every flag Friday after the final injury report and updates this page.
outro_md: Tiers are courses. The top of a tier is the safest plate; the bottom is where the flags live. A questionable player keeps his action and carries the flag until Friday. Specials are matchup plays outside the top tiers, and Off the Menu names the pivot for every player who is out.
